description: Source code implementing quantized linear operations with cuDNN backend in CUDA, including functions for setting parameters, caching execution plans, and applying fused operations like ReLU.

classes.name: QLinearInt8
classes.description: Template class providing static run methods for quantized linear operations with optional ReLU fusion.

methods.name: getLinearDescriptor
methods.description: Creates a cuDNN matrix multiplication descriptor with specified data type.

methods.name: setLinearParams
methods.description: Initializes LinearParams structure with input tensor, weight tensor, and configuration flags.

methods.name: apply_impl_helper
methods.description: Performs the core logic of applying quantized linear operation with optional ReLU fusion, including plan caching and execution.

methods.name: apply_impl
methods.description: Prepares output tensor and calls apply_impl_helper with appropriate template parameter for ReLU fusion.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes quantized linear operation without ReLU.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Executes quantized linear operation with fused ReLU.
